description: This Java class 'MongoPersistenceOperationsSelection' represents a selection criteria for MongoDB operations, encapsulating a collection name and a filter in BSON format. It provides methods for creation, access, and evaluation of whether the selection targets the entire collection or a subset.

classes.name: MongoPersistenceOperationsSelection
classes.description: Immutable class encapsulating a MongoDB collection name and filter for specific database operations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance with specified collection name and filter.

methods.name: getCollectionName
methods.description: Returns the name of the MongoDB collection.

methods.name: getFilter
methods.description: Returns a copy of the filter Document used in the selection.

methods.name: isEntireCollection
methods.description: Indicates whether the filter is empty, meaning the operation targets the entire collection.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on collection name and filter.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on collection name and filter.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation indicating the collection and whether it is a complete or filtered selection.
